title: Package source on the legacy V2 protocol
description: nuget.config declares a source pinned to protocol version 2. Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a source pinned to protocol version 2.
remediation: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a source pinned to protocol version 2.
limitation: It matches a source pinned to protocol version 2 in the parsed nuget.config; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
